sections.heading: Dedicated to Derron & Rosie
sections.text_summary: The BarKode program was born out of profound necessity and heartbreaking loss. It is dedicated to Derron, a veteran, and his beloved service dog, Rosie. Their story highlighted a critical gap in the safety protocols for working dog teams when emergencies strike. || When a veteran experiences a medical emergency in public, first responders need immediate access to vital information—not only about the veteran, but also about the service dog standing guard. Without clear identification and instructions, dogs can be separated from their handlers or misunderstood in chaotic situations. BarKode ensures this never happens again.
sections.layout_notes: py-20 max-w-4xl; bg-primary/5 rounded-2xl p-8/12; heading centered, paragraphs text-left

sections.heading: How BarKode Protects
items: Instant Identification [qr-code] — Every Heartland K9 wears a specialized patch featuring a unique BarKode. First responders can instantly identify the dog as a certified, trained service animal.
Emergency Contacts [phone-call] — Scanning the BarKode provides immediate access to emergency contact protocols, ensuring the dog's well-being is managed safely while the veteran receives care.
Legitimacy & Trust [shield-check] — In an era of fraudulent service dogs, BarKode serves as undeniable proof of the team's rigorous training and certification through Heartland K9s.

# Discovery Completeness Review — Heartland K9s WP conversion

## Verified spot-checks (re-fetched / re-read today)

1. **Live 5 Questions are self-assessment, not eligibility** — CONFIRMED from `live/pages.json` id 16: Q1 "Am I financially able… 10 to 15 years?" … Q5 "Are you prepared to deal with conflict?"; page says "no wrong answers" and "not meant to be answered with a simple 'yes' or 'no'". Reference's 5 yes/no questions appear nowhere live.
2. **Broken forms** — CONFIRMED: `/contact/` (2032) renders literal `[ccf_form id="2132"]` after "12651 Gateway Dr / Neosho MO 64850 / 800-913-6189 / Director cell: 417-312-7484"; `/online-application/` (1989) renders literal `[ccf_form id="2156"]`.
3. **Event is past** — CONFIRMED: `/events/` text "Date: 25 July 2026 Gates open at 6 PM game starts at 7 pm Location: Joe Becker Stadium Joplin MO… $3 of each ticket goes to Heartland".
4. **Master template is public/indexable** — CONFIRMED: `curl https://heartlandk9s.org/master_template_barkode/` → 200, canonical self, **no noindex**, listed in `sitemap-post-type-page.xml` (40 URLs total).
5. **Tex record leaks PII in `<meta name="description">` and `og:description`** — CONFIRMED live (handler full name + phone in both tags; values withheld).
6. **Hidden media 2061** — CONFIRMED: `/wp-json/wp/v2/media/2061` → 401; `/?p=2061` → 301 `?attachment_id=2061`. `/homepage-hero-1/` → 404.
7. **Live redirects** — CONFIRMED: `http://`→https 301; `www.`→apex 301; `/contact`→`/contact/`; `/slide/heartland-hero/`, `/slide-page/homepage-fusion/`, `/author/hk9director/` → `/` 301; attachment pages 301 → raw file; `/tag/poker-run/` and `/tag/veterans-day/` → **200 empty archives** (0 posts).
8. **No "nationwide", "Monday", "Mon–Fri", "across the country" anywhere** in the 40 pages or `home.html` — CONFIRMED by full-text scan. `/how-it-works…/` never mentions "discharge"/"honorable".
9. **Platform versions** — CONFIRMED: WP version-check API offers 7.1 (min PHP 7.4); npm `bootstrap` dist-tags `latest=5.3.8` (2025-08-26). Live `<meta generator>` = WordPress 7.1.
10. **Reference bundle claims** — CONFIRMED: exactly 13 `https://heartlandk9s.org/` occurrences in `ref/index.js`; `--primary-border` referenced once and never defined in `ref/index.css`; zero `.hover-elevate` rules; form inputs have `name=""` (`measure/interact.json` formValidity).
11. **Logo "EST. 2015"** — live/reference logo is byte-identical (media report) and the artwork carries an "EST. 2015" rocker; plus Ted Donaldson bio. Founding year is better supported than REFERENCE's "partially verified" implies.
12. **Live BarKode homepage copy says "how we provide the public with certification of our K9 Teams"** — so REFERENCE's "certification claim unverified" is partly supported.

## Gaps

**Truncated agent outputs.** DESIGN ends mid-sentence ("Radius 2px everywhere (rounded-m"), LIVE CONTENT ends at "K9 PROVIDERS … Vie", PLATFORM ends after the Chrome line. Anything after those points (remaining DESIGN components/footer/form specs, remaining LIVE conflicts, PLATFORM's remaining tool list) is unknown to this review.

**Route coverage.** Reference = 8 routes + a dev-stub 404 ("Did you forget to add the page to the router?"). Live = 23 non-registry public pages + 16 registry records + master template. **22 live pages have no reference design**: `/5-questions/`, `/online-application/`, `/service-dogs-and-the-ada/`, `/privacy-policy/`, `/donate/`, `/back-the-pack/`, `/volunteer/`, `/photos/`, `/events/`, `/thank-you/`, `/success/` (+child), `/campaigns/`, `/meet-the-team/`, `/the-service-k9-program/`, `/how-it-works-veteran-consideration/`, `/hk9-current-teams-in-training/`, `/our-highlighted-team/`, `/heartland-gear/`, `/the-hk9-coloring-book/`, `/heartland-obedience-training-2/`, `/master_template_barkode/`. No reference pattern exists for: photo gallery (71 imgs), partner logo grid, person cards, campaign records, event card, sponsor-tier table, price list, legal page, application form, donation page (Zeffy/PayPal/Amazon/mail-in), registry record, 404.

**Navigation.** Reference nav (7 links) drops live nav items PHOTOS, EVENTS, CAMPAIGNS, PARTNER WITH US, APPLICATION, ADA FAQs, 5 QUESTIONS, DONATE-page. Reference footer has no Privacy link (live has none either). Menus REST is 401, so nav was reconstructed from HTML only.

**Forms.** Both live form field sets are **unknown** (inactive plugin, admin-only). Application flow (screening → phone → emailed full application → physician PDF via `/thank-you/` with stale PO Box) has no owner in the reference. Reference contact form has no endpoint, no `name` attrs, no spam control.

**Live platform facts missing from PLATFORM output** (all verified by headers/HTML): host **Hostinger / LiteSpeed**, **PHP 8.3.31**, WP 7.1, **Avada 7.16.1 / Fusion Builder 3.16.1 / Fusion Core 5.16.1**, plugins: Slim SEO (**+ slim-seo-redirection namespace**), FooGallery + FooBox, Cookie Notice & Consent Banner, MonsterInsights, Simple History, Duplicate Post; Fathom site id `AMDWUGJX`; CSP `upgrade-insecure-requests` (masks the `http://` video source). Existing Slim SEO redirect rules are **unknown** (endpoint 404 anonymously). Private/draft pages and 2061's parent are **unknown**.

**Design measurements not taken.** Non-home routes measured only at 1440 and 390 (no 640/768/1024 for the program timeline, about/contact/veterans overlap cards, 3-col grids at 768 flagged "cramped"). No measurement of: toast appearance, `focus-visible` ring on buttons/links (only input focus), mobile-menu active state colors beyond class names, 404 styling, print. Live brand tokens (navy `#053360`, red `#e3111a`, cream `#fff5e1`, Avada `--h2_typography-*`) were never measured; the reference palette (`#1c2f4a`/`#b82e45`) is a departure from the current brand and from the red/blue logo — no decision recorded.

**Media.** No replacement mapping from the 5 AI-generated reference photos to real live photos; no OG image chosen; no favicon (reference SVG is a placeholder, live is a 512 PNG crop); video keep/drop undecided; `ID-Back.png` (Larry/Archie) may contain printed PII inside the image — not inspected; 2061 `Homepage-Hero-1.jpg` (2048x824, 2020) unaccounted for.

## Contradictions

- **Program order**: reference matches after training; live matches first, then trains (service training not before 7 months). LIVE flagged it; REFERENCE did not.
- **K9 providers**: REFERENCE says "no providers page"; LIVE documents `/the-service-k9-program/` ("Apply to provide a K9", breeder criteria, $18,000). That *is* the providers page — map "View Our Providers"/"K9 Providers" there.
- **Reference "specialized patch / proprietary / registry"** vs live "unique team number and QR code… secure database… voluntary… free only for HK9 teams; outside teams after evaluation and annual fee". Live is the source of truth; keep the annual-fee clause.
- **K9 intake age**: "10 weeks–16 months" accepted vs "older than 14 months" rejected on the same live page — unresolved.
- **Chris Flemming/Fleming**; **hours weekdays**; **nationwide vs 4-state area**; **Est. 2015 vs homepage published 2017** (logo + bio favor 2015).
- **Testimonials**: all four reference quotes are fabricated; the only real quote is from a board member (Madison Stratton) — needs disclosure if used.
- **Donate targets**: reference → root; live → Zeffy primary, PayPal hosted button still live, Amazon wishlist, mail-in.

## Risks for the plan

1. **QR permanence**: 16 registry URLs (mixed slugs, underscores, inconsistent IDs; 6 with no ID) are printed on physical patches — any slug change breaks emergency lookups.
2. **PII exposure**: registry pages are indexed, in the sitemap, and leak into meta/og; Mosby has a home street address; Meet-the-Team publishes a personal email.
3. **Fabricated content** (questions, testimonials, "nationwide", "Mon–Fri", "elite providers… breeding") shipping as fact.
4. **Unknown form schemas** block the plugin build; medical data must not be collected online.
5. **Orphans with recent edits** (`/heartland-obedience-training-2/` modified 2026-03, unlinked) — client intent unknown.
6. **~1.1 GB uploads / 8–18 MB originals**; 93 unreferenced files; 9 duplicate groups.
7. Tag archives return 200 with no content (thin pages); master template indexable.

## Recommended plan decisions

**Content model (plugin CPTs/meta):** `hk9_barkode` (dog, program_type [service|therapy|in-training], registry_id + legacy_id, breed, task_category, tasks[], handler, emergency_contact, vet_contact, certification, status, photo, id_card_image, notes); `hk9_team` (veteran, K9, status, story, donate CTA, link→barkode); `hk9_person` (role, bio, portrait, org email only, order); `hk9_partner` (logo, URL, tier, campaign link); `hk9_campaign` (summary, CTA, sponsor tiers as repeater, sponsors→partners); `hk9_event` (start/end, venue, ticket URL, flyer, auto-past); `hk9_story` (hide section until real, consented stories exist); gallery via core block or FooGallery import. Keep Pages for marketing/legal.

**URL ownership:** keep all 40 live slugs resolving. Adopt reference IA as new top-level pages with 301s: `/how-it-works-veteran-consideration/`→`/program`, `/5-questions/` stays (linked from `/veterans`), `/success/*`→`/stories` (delete sample), `/volunteer/`+`/campaigns/`+`/back-the-pack/` stay as children of `/get-involved`, `/thank-you/`→new application-thanks page (drop PO Box), `/heartland-obedience-training-2/`→`/obedience-training/`. **Never redirect or rename registry slugs**; add canonical `/barkode/<ID>/` aliases that 301 *to* the legacy slug. Master template: private/410. Tags/author/slide archives: 301 → `/` (replicate existing). Export Slim SEO redirection rules from admin before cut-over; replace Slim SEO sitemap with core sitemap excluding registry + template.

**Registry handling:** `noindex, nofollow` + `X-Robots-Tag` on records (still 200 for QR); generic meta/og descriptions; strip handler name/phone from titles; remove residential address; client privacy sign-off per record; normalise IDs to one scheme while preserving legacy IDs; generate QR PNGs from stored URLs.

**Events/campaigns:** event CPT with date-driven "upcoming/past" archive; import 2021–2026 flyers as past events; campaigns as 5 records, sponsor logos mapped to partners; sponsor tiers as structured pricing.

**Facts to resolve with client before copywriting:** hours/days, service area, eligibility criteria, provider criteria age window, Flemming/Fleming, real testimonials, video, palette (reference vs brand), Zeffy vs `/donate/` as CTA target, PayPal retirement.

**Platform:** target `wordpress:php8.3-apache` (matches live PHP 8.3.31), Bootstrap 5.3.8 pinned, self-hosted Fraunces/Inter (OFL), Lucide sprite (ISC), keep Fathom + cookie banner, rewrite privacy policy.
